summary: A genuine larger model (stories110M, ~110 MB Q6_K / ~86 MB Q4_K) whose every weight dimension is divisible by 256 was converted and quantized with pinned llama.cpp tooling and run through the streamed decoder. Unlike the prior mixed-quant stories15M fixtures, EVERY eligible weight tensor is a real K-quant superblock (86 Q6_K, or 73 Q4_K + 13 Q6_K) with zero 32-element fallback. Streamed output is byte-identical to the resident llama.cpp reference over 16 greedy tokens; a new multi-position logit comparison shows top-1 agreement at all 16 positions with bounded per-position RMSE; and the 110 MB model runs out-of-core in a 64 MB address space at ~19 MB peak RSS. This closes the prior session's 'fully-K-quant UNTESTED' gap.

source.note: No decoder code changed for the larger model; the K-quant allowlist (001f1c5) and the multi-position harness (5f12397) are the committed code under test. This file is evidence only. git dirty at record: this evidence file + .vscode/ untracked.

real_inference.note_workspace: stories110M needs workspace_mb >= ~10 (KV+activations for 12 layers x 128 ctx x 768 kvdim); the 8 MB default is correctly rejected with 'streamed KV/activation workspace exceeds budget' - a bounded admission check, not a crash.

multi_position_logit_validation.method: llmbridge logit-diff --max-tokens 16: per-position comparison of streamed vs resident logits over the greedy-decoded sequence; prefix_identical_through counts leading positions whose argmax agrees across backends (alignment validity bound).

numerical_root_cause.question: Why do streamed logits differ from resident llama.cpp when generated tokens match?
numerical_root_cause.conclusion: Permissible FP32 forward-pass precision differences between two independent implementations - NOT quantization error and NOT a defect. No code change made.
evidence: Quantization-independent: Q8_0 (near-lossless weights) shows position-0 RMSE 0.185, LARGER than Q6_K's 0.0136 and comparable to Q4_K - so the divergence is dominated by forward-pass arithmetic, not weight quantization.
Depth-independent: stories110M Q6_K (12 layers) position-0 RMSE 0.0136 is LOWER than stories15M Q6_K (6 layers) 0.057 - a per-layer accumulating defect would grow with depth, not shrink.
Bounded and benign: top-1 agrees at every one of 16 positions for both models and all six formats; top-10 overlap 9-10/10; zero non-finite values.

Likely contributors (equivalent-but-not-bit-identical paths, not isolated to one op): FP32 accumulation order in ggml vec_dot vs the decoder's row loop, padded softmax (decoder pads attention to 256 and uses ggml_vec_soft_max_f32), incremental RoPE angle recurrence, and RMSNorm double accumulation.
numerical_root_cause.decision: No production correction (Task J): forcing bit-exactness would require replacing the custom out-of-core decoder with llama.cpp's in-memory graph, defeating the bounded-memory design. The correctness bar is deterministic token + top-k agreement, met in full; the observed logit-RMSE envelope (<= ~0.25 per position) is documented as the justified tolerance.

bounded_memory.interpretation: A 110 MB (Q6_K) / 86 MB (Q4_K) model runs in a 64 MB enforced address space at ~19 MB peak RSS, streaming ~0.8-1.0 GB of weight reads across the run in <=65 KB ranges with zero cache allocation. Out-of-core bounded-memory inference is preserved at ~4-5x the previous model size; peak RSS is dominated by the fixed workspace (KV+activations+logits), not model size.
bounded_memory.read_amplification_note: ~9x source bytes vs model size over 16 tokens reflects per-token re-streaming of all weights (out-of-core) plus the authenticated mutation-detection re-read; this is the documented synchronous design, not a regression.
bounded_memory.threads: 2 logical threads used; CPU affinity was not pinned (documented limitation).

security_regression.note: No decoder or security code changed for this experiment. The committed code under test keeps authentication, sealed-manifest verification, source-mutation detection, deadline/cancellation, worker lifecycle, memory admission and isfinite guards intact.

compatibility_matrix.status: UNSUPPORTED (metadata allowlist / extra tensors / NEOX rope, unchanged)

limitations: Deterministic greedy decoding; sampling-based decoding not compared.
Logit comparison at 16 positions with ctx 128; longer contexts and larger max_tokens not swept.
Enforced memory tested at 64 MB (already ~3x headroom over ~19 MB RSS); 256/512/1024/2048 MB limits were not separately recorded because they pass trivially.
CPU affinity not pinned to 2 logical processors (2 threads used).
WSL2 virtualized, not physical hardware; memory numbers are address-space/RSS bounds.
cgroup memory.max not tested (no passwordless sudo); RLIMIT_AS used as the enforced bound.
Per-token TTFT/decode throughput for stories110M not isolated in this evidence; source-read and RSS metrics are recorded instead.
